_comment: Tier-2 for skfem poisson#7. Confirms the L2 order deg+1 part of the claim for P1/P2/P3 by measuring it (brackets asserted, no rate pinned). FALSIFIES the claim's Signal clause: it says the DEFAULT intorder 'under-integrates a transcendental error integrand and can cost you an apparent order'. Measured on skfem 12.0.1, the default costs nothing -- default vs explicit intorder=2*deg+3 give the same orders to two decimals for all three degrees. What DOES destroy the answer is an explicitly too-low assembly intorder: P3 with intorder=2 produces an error ~1e14 and NEGATIVE rates. The fixture pins the real pathology and the falsification together.
